headline: PAID CREATOR POSTS AVERAGED 334,055 VIEWS AND FREE PRODUCT POSTS AVERAGED 48,008.  GLOSSY, WHICH RAN THE NUMBERS, SAYS THE ROUGHLY SEVENFOLD GAP IS LIKELY LINKED TO THE MEDIA BUDGET BEHIND THE PAID ONES RATHER THAN TO BETTER CONTENT
deck: Glossy published its 2026 Creator Marketing Index on Tuesday, and buried in it is the most useful correction you will read this month.  Sponsored creator posts out-reached free-product ones by about seven to one.  Then Glossy says the margin is likely also linked to budget differences: brands hand creators a paid budget to push sponsored posts past their own followers, while a free-product post only ever reaches the creator's own audience.  Which means the comparison everybody will quote is not creative against creative.  It is paid distribution against none.
tldr: Glossy's index has sponsored creator posts averaging 334,055 views against 48,008 for free-product ones, and says the gap is likely linked in large part to the paid budget behind the sponsored posts rather than to better content.  Split every creator report you send into reach the content earned and reach you bought, label them separately, and judge gifted programmes on engagement rate instead of views.

Comcast's domestic advertising grew 14.6 percent, and 0.3 percent once you strip the World Cup out, which added 224 million dollars across the Media segment — the company printed both advertising rows in its own filing.  Put those two numbers on one slide for your next planning conversation, and check every 2027 forecast on your desk for whether its base year contains a World Cup.

Since 24 August a YouTube view has been counted the moment a video starts playing, across long-form and live, and no historical data has been restated.  Draw a hard line at that date in every benchmark you keep, and start reporting engaged views and engaged watch hours from Advanced Mode alongside public views.

Meta says partnership adverts — paid media run from the creator's own handle — have passed a 15 billion dollar annual run rate, growing more than 97 percent in a year, with 10 million creators discoverable to advertisers.  Move one campaign off brand-page boosting and onto partnership ads so the advert runs from the creator's handle, and keep everything else constant to get a clean read.

Five Below sponsored one creator video last week and got 18,430,482 views, beating OpenAI's roughly ten-video run whose best did 9,624,477.  Name the single occasion, season or competitor your next creator video attaches itself to before you split the budget, and drop any creator whose audience would not buy the product.

Nearly 45 percent of recommended Reels are now under a day old, up more than 11 points in one quarter.  Pre-approve a format, a caption structure and three fallback claims with legal this month so one person can shoot, cut and publish inside 24 hours, and measure that lane separately from your hero asset.

Creators' own co-streams took almost half the hours watched across 15 major esports tournaments last quarter, while the VALORANT world final peak grew 1.21 percent.  Ask every rights holder for the official-feed share of hours at last year's edition before you sign, and build a three-name co-streamer shortlist for each event in your 2027 plan.
